state_generation.state_policy: uniform over state-local deduplicated PF0 effective legal actions
state_generation.scenario_cycle: exact R7.4 domain scenario cycle; hand_index modulo scenario_count
state_generation.collection: Start fresh exact hands and follow candidate-independent uniform PF0 using keyed uniforms until exactly 2048 nonterminal decision states are retained; truncate only the final hand prefix needed to hit 2048.
replay_descriptor: ordered effective universal slot path from root to state

cross_seed_policy_stability.states: first 1024 heldout states for each domain/evaluation_seed, identical for both training-seed models
cross_seed_policy_stability.metric: total variation distance between the two final AveragePolicy distributions of the same representation on identical SPNNIV3/legal-mask states
cross_seed_policy_stability.aggregate: all two evaluation_seed cells per domain; report cell and pooled mean/p50/p95/max

local_deviation_proxy.name: ONE_STEP_SELF_CONTINUATION_DEVIATION_GAIN
local_deviation_proxy.utility: ICM_EXACT_V1 payout delta for actor at heldout state
local_deviation_proxy.root_action_set: all state-local deduplicated PF0 exact actions available at the heldout state
local_deviation_proxy.candidate_policy_value: sum over root actions of candidate AveragePolicy probability times Q(candidate, root_action)
local_deviation_proxy.per_state_gain: best_local_value - candidate_policy_value; nonnegative up to floating tolerance

continuation.all_future_players_use: same candidate final AveragePolicy being evaluated
continuation.target_player_future_nodes: enumerate all effective PF0 actions and probability-weight by candidate AveragePolicy
continuation.opponent_nodes_after_exact_levels: sample one PF0 action from candidate AveragePolicy
continuation.chance: already fixed by exact replayed hand/deck state

local_deviation_proxy.interpretation: Lower is better. This is a candidate-native one-step deviation/convergence proxy, not exact exploitability.

common_reference_crossplay.reference: candidate-independent uniform-over-effective-PF0 policy for every seat
common_reference_crossplay.candidate_test: one physical seat uses candidate final AveragePolicy; all other seats use uniform PF0
common_reference_crossplay.score: candidate-seat terminal ICM delta in candidate test minus same physical seat terminal ICM delta in all-uniform reference hand
common_reference_crossplay.selection_role: diagnostic/sanity only; exploitation of a uniform opponent is not an equilibrium-quality winner criterion

pairwise_H2_H3_crossplay.mirrored_seat_test: For each physical candidate seat and exact hand, run H3 in that seat vs H2 on all other live seats, then H2 in the same seat vs H3 on all other live seats, using the same deck and keyed policy uniforms.
pairwise_H2_H3_crossplay.score_H3_perspective: 0.5 * [(H3-seat ICM delta vs H2 opponents) - (H2-seat ICM delta vs H3 opponents)]

hard_checks: zero probability on illegal actions after masking
at least two distinct policy vectors to 1e-8 among multi-action sentinel states
fixed_sentinels.reason: Sentinels detect collapse/integration errors without injecting human poker intuition into winner selection.

selection_rule.prerequisite: Candidate must pass structural/resource admission, all training-quality gates, fixed sentinels and both domains.
selection_rule.primary_comparison: paired H3-minus-H2 local-deviation gain difference; negative favors H3
selection_rule.secondary_comparison: pairwise mirrored H3-vs-H2 crossplay score; positive favors H3
selection_rule.clear_H3: local-deviation 95% CI is materially below zero and pairwise crossplay is not materially H2-favoring, OR pairwise crossplay is materially H3-favoring and local-deviation is not materially H2-favoring
selection_rule.clear_H2: local-deviation 95% CI is materially above zero and pairwise crossplay is not materially H3-favoring, OR pairwise crossplay is materially H2-favoring and local-deviation is not materially H3-favoring
selection_rule.conflict: If one primary metric materially favors H2 and the other materially favors H3, Phase 2 is INCONCLUSIVE/BLOCKED for representation selection; do not average away the conflict.
selection_rule.one_candidate_fails_hard_gate: The passing candidate may advance only if no pairwise strategic metric materially favors the failed candidate; otherwise BLOCKED for diagnosis.
selection_rule.both_pass_and_both_material_comparisons_: Select H2 as the smaller/faster Phase-2 representation tie-break, exactly following the precommit. H3 remains eligible for the separately precommitted H4 capacity-reinvestment experiment if its structural/resource/training gates passed.

forbidden: generate heldout states from H2 or H3 policy
put representation or training-seed identity into poker-state/deal/policy-uniform RNG keys
reuse training seeds as evaluation seeds
change heldout counts, crossplay hands, bootstrap replicates, material floor or winner logic after outputs
use V1-generated labels or V1 policy as ground-truth referee
select H3 merely because it is more semantically appealing
select H2 merely because it is faster if a strategic metric materially favors H3
